item.title: Official entry info for Malawi was updated (Nov 26, 2026). Travel advice: Level 2 🟡 Increased caution. Why: Polio vaccine no longer required for entering Malawi
item.dc:creator: 🇲🇼 Malawi
item.description: UK government note: "Removal of polio as a vaccine requirement when entering Malawi ('Entry requirements' page)." Updates like this can affect other passports too, so check the official entry rules for your passport before you book or travel. From The Escape Plan travel data. General information, not legal advice. Always check the official source before you travel.
